answer: Forging a new identity costs a fresh key plus a shale-based compute burn that escalates per epoch, making mass fake accounts economically irrational because each sybil pays the same escalating stake as a real participant. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work tied to a physical resource: each agent must stake a unique hardware-bound cipher key that a trusted grove of validators verifies on-chain. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
